memory._anomaly_threshold_note: RECALIBRATED 2026-07-02 against real production memories (58 real e5-small embeddings from the live MATHIR project, not just the narrower tests/data/anomaly_eval/ corpus): normal_mean=18.49, normal_std=1.96 (wider than the eval corpus's std=0.69 -- real production content is more heterogeneous). Threshold = mean + 3*std (~24.4, rounded to 25.0), the standard 3-sigma rule for a low false-positive rate. The previous value (20.0, only ~0.8 std above this wider mean) was over-flagging real production content -- measured 11.9% of real memories flagged anomalous before this fix, far above a sane false-positive rate.
